claim: Born in El Salvador and raised on Long Island
finding: Born in El Salvador, moved to the U.S. at age 3, and lives in Brentwood.

claim: An educator and former Assistant Principal
finding: Taught social studies at Brentwood High School, then became assistant principal of Brentwood's East Middle School in 2010.

claim: Previously served in the Suffolk County Legislature
Enhanced the Empire State Child Credit: up to $1,000 per child under 4 from 2025, and $500 for ages 4–16 in 2026–27
finding: The figures match the FY2026 budget. It was a statewide budget measure (the Governor's proposal); her role was her vote.

claim: $340 million for free breakfast and lunch for all students, a first
finding: Matches the FY2026 budget's universal school meals funding. Statewide budget item.

claim: Foundation Aid totals $26 billion, with at least a 2% increase for all schools
finding: FY2026 Foundation Aid was about $26.4 billion. Statewide budget item.

claim: The budget allocates $8 billion to clear the unemployment insurance fund debt
finding: The FY2026 budget did repay the UI trust fund debt, but the Fiscal Policy Institute put that federal debt at about $6.2 billion. The $8 billion figure couldn't be matched.

claim: A record $425 million Environmental Protection Fund, $25 million above prior years
finding: Matches the FY2026 budget. Statewide budget item.

claim: A second straight year of increased CHIPS road funding, adding $100 million over two years
finding: Matches the FY2026 budget. Statewide budget item.

claim: Sponsored S7335 (Enhanced STAR for seniors), which passed the Senate
finding: She sponsors it and it passed the Senate on June 10, 2025. It died in the Assembly and is back in Senate committee in 2026, which the page doesn't say.

claim: Sponsored S902, S195, S5753 and S202 (vape products, kid-marketed vapes, the Tsakos act, sex-trafficking penalties)
finding: Bill sponsorship not individually checked in this core review.
